why: Play ships v2.101, exported by Glyphs.app from alexeiva/play sources/Play.glyphs at d84ad58 (investigations/play/FINDINGS.md). That source is cubic, and the release's TrueType hinting addresses the quadratic points Glyphs.app made from it, which no rebuild reproduces (17 of 1,150 glyphs point-identical); to keep the hinting, Play converts from the shipped fonts (Felipe, 2026-11-06; tools/probes/hinting/ROUTE-A.md).
earlier_sources: https://github.com/alexeiva/play at d84ad58f3a3bd2c735f431480f969283446b509f: sources/Play.glyphs, the cubic Glyphs source the release was exported from; its TrueType hinting cannot apply to a build from it.

googlefontdirectory-hg `ofl/play/src/Play-{Regular,Bold}-TTF.sfd` at 52f780bc9d19 (https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg): FontForge sources of v1.001/v1.002 (2011), the revision google/fonts METADATA.pb recorded before; they lack 133 of the shipped codepoints and the v2 feature code.
librefonts/play 0d4e17b (2014, https://github.com/librefonts/play): byte-identical copies of those .sfd plus TTX dumps.
google/fonts 874c7ceb1 (2016-10-31) added `ofl/play/Play-{Regular,Bold}.glyphs` (Glyphs 1 era), `Play-{Regular,Bold}.vfb` and `Play-Bold.vfbak`; e36afc756 deleted them.
m4rc1e/play 3565c8a (https://github.com/m4rc1e/play): a fork with a tree identical to this repository's d84ad58.
gdef_classes_fea: the release's GDEF classes, which a lookup filters on and which no glyph category of the converted source expresses
